name: Same-game parlay: spread + total
signal: Both legs are priced from the same game model; the parlay is quoted only at the measured rho, never at the naive product.
universe: any game in the window where both single-leg probabilities clear the threshold and both clubs are inside the luck noise band
settlement_rule: Official NBA final score and final total. Both legs must win; a push on either leg voids the parlay.
